subject: CLPM with count data in lavaan

messages.author: 63fc3018d9a4d650
messages.subject: CLPM with count data in lavaan
parts:
I am hoping to run a crossed-lagged model with two timepoints and two variables. One variable is continuous, and the other is symptom count (zero-inflated).

What would be the best approach for doing this with a count variable in such a model in lavaan? Is it possible?

Thanks in advance!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: CLPM with count data in lavaan
parts:
Is it possible?


No.  Mplus is the only standard SEM software I am aware of that has models with distributions/links appropriate for count outcomes.  The more general latent-variable software GLLAMM (in Stata) does, and maybe LatentGold, too.
